name: breadcrumb
description: Breadcrumb — spoiler-safe hints, chat guard and chat pulse for Twitch streamers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
